topography.project_purpose: Lending. Structurally: 92 project-authored contract(s) across 4 chain(s); 3 ERC4626 vaults, 9 ERC20 tokens, 4 ERC721 NFTs, 7 Chainlink feeds; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 9 functional families. Its contracts share 22 common project-authored base contract(s) (appaccesscontrolled, univ4positionhelper, baseadapter). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
